solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
solution_components.role: Indexes and retrieves vector embeddings for semantic search and generative-AI workflows.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Provides integrated full-text and faceted search across Trillia's application data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Trillia's workload.

data_flow: Documents, logs, or product records are stored in MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, embedded or indexed for MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, and queried by Trillia's application workflows to return relevant results in real time.
business_outcome: Trillia gained faster scaling, stronger security, and agility with MongoDB Atlas, shifting focus from maintenance to innovation.
metrics: Trillia Trillia powers data intelligence at scale B3’s Trillia unified 150 clusters on MongoDB Atlas, achieving zero‑downtime migration, faster scaling, and innovation at speed.
The eventual result was a fragmented landscape of 150 disparate clusters — some exceeding 20 TB of data — running a mix of versions and configurations without centralized governance.
The time required to deploy a new database cluster dropped from four hours — and in some cases a day — to just 10 minutes.
“And it was golden for our teams.” By integrating MongoDB Atlas SSO, Trillia reduced database access request times from 15 minutes to mere seconds.
